trial_court: Court No. 10 Ballia in criminal case no. 1746 of 2001
case_name: Smt. Usha Devi Wife Of Surendra Nath ... vs State Of U.P., Surendra Nath Singh Son Of ...

parties.respondent_defendant: State of U.P., Surendra Nath Singh (son)

facts_of_case: Complainant Smt. Usha Devi filed a complaint against accused Surendra Nath Singh and his bhabhi Smt. Savitri Devi under Sections 405, 498A IPC. She alleged that she was married to the accused but he had earlier married another woman who was turned out of the house. The complainant also alleged that her daughter was killed by the accused.

legal_principles.principle: A person who has a husband or wife living and marries in any case in which such marriage is void by reason of its taking place during the lifetime of such husband or wife commits the offence of bigamy.
legal_principles.held: The conjoint reading of these two sections shows that if a person has a husband or wife living and marries in any case in which such marriage is void by reason of its taking place during the lifetime of such husband or wife, commits the offence of bigamy.

legal_principles.principle: A person who conceals the fact of the earlier marriage commits a more serious offence.
legal_principles.held: The offence becomes more serious if he/she conceals the fact of the earlier marriage.

outcome.final_order: The trial court's judgment and order dated 20.3.2002 were set aside, and the case was remanded for retrial.

use_for_drafting: representing a wife in a domestic violence case
